description: Checks whether AI crawlers and search bots (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, Googlebot, Google-Extended, bingbot, Applebot-Extended, CCBot) can reach a page. For each bot it reports the robots.txt rule that applies and whether the server or firewall blocks that User-Agent (403, 429, dropped connection, challenge or captcha page) compared with a normal browser. Use it when someone asks why ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity or Google AI Overviews cannot see or cite their site.

bots.description: Optional subset of bots to check. Default: all.

url.description: Page to check, for example https://example.com/ or example.com/pricing

name: check_ai_bot_access
title: Check AI bot access
